_doc: Arena 11 (retail world 42: a jungle of carnivorous plants) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena7/kit.json. Its cracked paving (2313-2316) is in the arena 9 kit; pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.

green: verde lima, flores blancas y turquesa
verde oscuro, flores rosas y violeta
verde amarillo, flores crema y naranja

pieces.name: grass_fine
pieces.label: Hierba fina
pieces.note: long thin blades arcing to the sides; wider than a cell

pieces.name: grass_fine_broad
pieces.label: Hierba fina de hoja ancha
pieces.note: olive blades in front, fresh green behind

pieces.name: vine_heart
pieces.label: Enredadera de hojas de corazón
pieces.note: a twined stalk 2.6 m tall crowned by a heart leaf; pebbles at its foot

pieces.name: flower_vine
pieces.label: Enredadera con flores
pieces.note: 3.3 m, teal flowers at the top and on a side shoot

pieces.name: vine_tall
pieces.label: Enredadera alta
pieces.note: 4.3 m: thin stems, the leaves and white flowers bunched at 1.4-2.8 m

pieces.name: vine_crowns
pieces.label: Tallos con copa de hojas
pieces.note: two clumps of bare stems topped with heart leaves and white flowers

pieces.name: snap_plant
pieces.label: Planta carnívora
pieces.note: a stalk climbs 3 m to a big snapping pod; palm whorls lower; dead leaves at its foot. The retail draws these near-black at the rim: our light does that

pieces.name: snap_plant_low
pieces.label: Planta carnívora baja
pieces.note: its pod reaches out to the left

pieces.name: dark_palm
pieces.label: Palmera oscura
pieces.note: no pods; a big whorl of pale leaves in the middle

pieces.name: calla_pair
pieces.label: Calas
pieces.note: two blue-spadix callas over a rosette of brown leaves

pieces.name: fern_sprig
pieces.label: Ramita de helecho
pieces.note: lime zigzag sprigs 1.6 m tall over olive grass; the four retail sprites are the same plant

pieces.name: fan_sprouts
pieces.label: Brotes de abanico
pieces.note: two little fan palms on a creeping stem; 2781 is loom a (yellow), 2782 b (green), 2783 c (purple)

pieces.name: thorn_arches
pieces.label: Raíces con pinchos
pieces.note: an arch out of the ground and back, and a root curling over to its right

pieces.name: thorn_stub
pieces.label: Tocón de raíz con pinchos
pieces.note: owner grouped 2600 with the dry leaves; enlarged it is a broken thorny root

pieces.name: leaf_litter
pieces.label: Hojas secas
pieces.note: a drift of little brown heart leaves lying flat

pieces.name: stone_skull
pieces.label: Tótem calavera
pieces.note: a boulder 1.6 m carved as a skull on its +z face (square eyes, four teeth), an arch on its +x side

pieces.name: carved_block
pieces.label: Bloque tallado
pieces.note: a big pale spiral on its +x face; two fallen blocks at its front left

pieces.name: carved_block_small
pieces.label: Bloque tallado pequeño
pieces.note: a meander on its top, two slots on its +z face, a cube against its +x side

pieces.name: painted_rock
pieces.label: Roca con pintura
pieces.note: pale spirals painted on its two front faces

pieces.name: dry_stalk
pieces.label: Planta seca
pieces.note: a dead leaf stalk 2.3 m, its tip bowing to the left; green round leaves at its foot
